meta.title: Platform: Snowflake architecture & governance
meta.description: Why we build a data & AI practice native on Snowflake (Openflow, dbt, Snowpark, Horizon, Cortex, Iceberg): governance, lineage, and AI context in one place the team can run.

hero.title: Built <hl>native on Snowflake</hl>, not bolted on.
hero.description: Everything Viewnear builds runs inside Snowflake: ingestion through Openflow, transformation in Snowpark and dbt, governance in Horizon Catalog, and AI in Cortex. One governed copy of the data, one lineage trail, one place to grant access.

stackStory.title: One build, start to finish
stackStory.intro: What actually happens when we stand up a data foundation: who does what, where each product earns its place, and where the team takes over. dbt is the one external framework we run, natively against Snowflake.

onScreen.title: What a governed build looks like
onScreen.intro: Screens from our build environments, not mockups: the surface the business sees, the engineering behind it, and the governance that makes both trustworthy.

conviction.title: We could stitch five tools together. We won't.
conviction.intro: Snowflake sells the platform; we answer for what gets built on it. Every extra tool is another copy of the data, another system to secure, and another place lineage breaks, so building native is how we keep that promise:

whyNative.title: One governed copy
whyNative.body: No exports, no shadow stacks: the data stays in one place with governance attached.

whyNative.title: One lineage to audit
whyNative.body: Lineage, access, and policy enforced in a single place that stands up to an audit.

whyNative.title: Grounded AI
whyNative.body: Agents inherit trusted, certified business context instead of guessing from copies.

whyNative.title: Open by design
whyNative.body: Apache Iceberg keeps the same governed copy portable and queryable by any engine.

partsList.title: The parts list
partsList.intro: Every product we reach for, and the one-line reason. dbt is the lone external framework; everything else stays native.

layers.blurb: Get every source in, batch or streaming, without bolting on a separate ETL vendor.

products.name: Openflow
products.desc: Managed integration on Apache NiFi; batch + streaming, BYOC or Snowflake-managed.

products.name: Snowpipe Streaming
products.desc: Low-latency, continuous ingestion straight into governed tables.

products.name: Datastream
products.desc: Managed, Kafka-compatible streaming; data inherits Snowflake governance automatically.

products.name: Zero-Copy Integrations
products.desc: Native links to SAP, Salesforce, Workday & more, with no data duplication.

layers.blurb: Model and transform in-platform, in the languages the team already uses.

products.name: dbt
products.desc: Our transformation framework of choice, run natively against Snowflake.

products.name: Snowpark
products.desc: Python/Java/Scala pipelines and UDFs executing next to the data.

products.name: Dynamic Tables
products.desc: Declarative, incremental pipelines that keep derived data fresh.

layers.blurb: One governed copy of the data, open to every engine.

products.name: Apache Iceberg v3
products.desc: Open table format with deletion vectors, row lineage, and variant types.

products.name: Open Catalog (Polaris)
products.desc: Bi-directional read/write catalog so Snowflake and external lakes share one source.

products.name: Snowflake-managed Iceberg
products.desc: A single live, governed copy across Snowflake and the lake, with no movement.

layers.blurb: Governance, lineage, and trusted business context built in: the foundation AI actually needs.

products.name: Horizon Catalog
products.desc: Lineage, access history, classification, and policy across the estate.

products.name: Horizon Context
products.desc: Collect, enrich, and activate metadata with semantic + keyword search.

products.name: Cortex Sense
products.desc: Runtime layer that assembles data + business definitions for AI agents.

products.name: Semantic Views
products.desc: Shared business definitions so every query and agent speaks the same language.

products.name: AI Agent Identity
products.desc: Verifiable identity and per-agent RBAC for every AI agent, with full audit trails.

layers.blurb: Production AI that runs securely next to governed data; models never see ungoverned copies. The MLOps loop stays in one place: train, deploy, monitor, retrain.

products.name: Cortex AISQL
products.desc: Call LLMs and ML functions directly from SQL: COMPLETE, SENTIMENT, SUMMARIZE.

products.name: Cortex Analyst
products.desc: Natural-language questions answered against governed semantic models.

products.name: Snowflake CoWork
products.desc: Agentic, cited answers and governed dashboards for knowledge workers.

products.name: Snowflake CoCo
products.desc: Coding agent for enterprise AI development, validated before production.

products.name: Cortex Training
products.desc: Fine-tune open-weight models on managed GPUs; data never moves.

layers.blurb: Put insight where people work: on governed data, not a separate BI stack to secure.

products.name: Snowsight
products.desc: Governed dashboards and ad-hoc exploration out of the box.

products.name: Streamlit in Snowflake
products.desc: Interactive data apps shipped right next to the data.

products.name: Snowflake CoWork
products.desc: Ask-in-plain-language analytics for the whole business.

cta.title: Put the practice on one governed stack.
cta.subtitle: Tell us what runs today. We'll map the fastest path to a single, governed foundation on Snowflake, what to retire along the way, and where the team takes over.
